channel.title: Delta Signal ATLAS-7 Changelog
channel.description: Public changelog for Delta Signal ATLAS-7 MCP, OpenAPI, x402, notification, SPECTRA, and evidence-contract changes.

item.title: Design-partner grant expiry fields and Natural Language route coverage deployed
item.description: Production now exposes grant_expires_at and grant_expires_in_seconds for the actual grant window, separates those fields from the short challenge/session TTL, and allows grant-covered Natural Language routes through the signed wallet grant-session flow when included in the active grant contract. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Design-partner grant expiry fields and Natural Language route coverage deployed Track: T+1106m Commit: live rollout ca-web-intel-mcp--0000536

item.title: Design-partner grant runway and expiry contract clarified
item.description: The public contract now clarifies that design-partner grant runway should be sized from grant_budget_usd and grant_remaining_usd, that grant_limit is only a compatibility view, that route-priced grant debit is server-side, and that issued design-partner grants expire 30 days after issuance unless separately renewed. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Design-partner grant runway and expiry contract clarified Track: T+1098m Commit: current changelog update

item.title: Audit-grade Natural Language Morning Brief renderer deployed
item.description: Production now serves audit-grade Natural Language Morning Brief output from Azure revision ca-web-intel-mcp--0000527, with score interpretation, concrete risk-distribution snapshot, stale source-period caveats, safer route recommendations, and cached/precomputed MCP reuse. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Audit-grade Natural Language Morning Brief renderer deployed Track: T+1090m Commit: 981f25ae

item.title: Claude Code MCP project guide added
item.description: The repository now includes a full CLAUDE.md guide for Claude Code work on the Delta Signal ATLAS-7 / SPECTRA / x402 / TripCode research-agent stack. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Claude Code MCP project guide added Track: T+1082m Commit: current changelog update

item.title: Coinbase x402 and Codex marketplace reviewer positioning
item.description: The public docs and marketplace metadata now frame Delta Signal ATLAS-7 as a Codex-ready, x402-payable issuer-intelligence evidence service for reviewers: install, discover, inspect route metadata, trigger 402, retry with proof, and inspect provenance. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Coinbase x402 and Codex marketplace reviewer positioning Track: T+1074m Commit: current changelog update

item.title: LLM evidence-routing guardrails and TripCode discovery caveat
item.description: The LLM handoff files and plugin skill now explicitly separate ATLAS-7 as the SEC/XBRL evidence layer, SPECTRA as the ATLAS-history field-map layer, and TripCode/River research as discovery-gated unless the live MCP tools and required River/index blobs are present. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > LLM evidence-routing guardrails and TripCode discovery caveat Track: T+1066m Commit: current changelog update

item.title: Live readiness and MCP evidence hardening deployed
item.description: Production now serves the hardened DeltaSignal readiness and MCP evidence surface from Azure revision ca-web-intel-mcp--0000484, with 56 OpenAPI paths, live pricing discovery, live field-contract discovery, structured invalid-path-scope errors, and a 97.5% cmd/search-gateway source coverage checkpoint. item.description: The public docs now explain SPECTRA as the field-map contract layer derived from ATLAS-history-shaped rows: ticker/source-date resolution, numeric/date/boolean normalization, pressure and range labels, provenance, caveats, and structured soft-miss behavior. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > SPECTRA generation model documented Track: T+1050m Commit: current changelog update
